description: A PHP trait defining methods for an HTTP client interface, including both synchronous and asynchronous request methods for various HTTP verbs like GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Abstract method to create and send an HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to create and send an asynchronous HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Synchronous method to perform an HTTP GET request.

methods.name: head
methods.description: Synchronous method to perform an HTTP HEAD request.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Synchronous method to perform an HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Synchronous method to perform an HTTP POST request.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Synchronous method to perform an HTTP PATCH request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Synchronous method to perform an HTTP DELETE request.

methods.name: getAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to perform an HTTP GET request.

methods.name: headAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to perform an HTTP HEAD request.

methods.name: putAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to perform an HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: postAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to perform an HTTP POST request.

methods.name: patchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to perform an HTTP PATCH request.

methods.name: deleteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method to perform an HTTP DELETE request.
